verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub organization (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), and a probe confirms it is documented there, so agents can connect to Elasticsearch through a first-party MCP server. The evidence only establishes that the server exists, not what it can do. Missing for 10: details of exposed tools and capabilities, setup and auth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.
